text:
jules: Heads-up — after the console change that shortened stream idle timeout for canary, we saw a burst of half-close reconnect races and duplicate resume events. Affected tenants reported short blips and a few billing anomalies.

patrick: Which console toggle was flipped? idle timeout or affinity?

jules: Both actually. The canary set `stream.idle_timeout_ms=1000` and switched `session_affinity_mode=route_preferred`. The intention was to free up sockets quickly.

emily: Oof. Shortening idle_time triggers client reconnects that don't always complete the WS close handshake before the route flip. Edge logs show resume attempts + half-close followed by immediate re-auth. Snippet: 
```
2026-07-20T21:05:11.123Z INFO ws_half_close session=sess-321 reason=idletimer
2026-07-20T21:05:11.125Z INFO resume_attempt session=sess-321 token=tok-52 route=eu-a
2026-07-20T21:05:11.130Z INFO route_reassign session=sess-321 from=eu-a to=eu-fast flag=route_preferred
2026-07-20T21:05:11.132Z INFO resume_attempt session=sess-321 token=tok-52 route=eu-fast
```
This race caused two resume events close together and runtime sometimes ACKed only the second one. Billing pipeline uses first resume -> charge.

patrick: Telemetry visibility? Can we slice by cohort?

emily: Not easily. The resume metric lost `session_affinity` and `console_cohort` tags because the metric-forwarder dropped unknown labels introduced by the console. We couldn't see the canary slice until CS flagged customers.

metrics-bot: Created alert rule: resume_dups/session > 3 in 2m -> page eng-oncall.

ops: Short-term mitigation options: 1) rollback idle_timeout to previous value (30s) for canary cohort, 2) backend debounce for identical session+token within 2s (no billing emit), 3) require runtime resume_ack before billing event.

jules: I'd prefer server-side debounce first (fast to roll out) + telemetry fix so we can see cohorts, then rollback if needed.

patrick: Agree on debounce. I'll sketch a minimal change in session_manager: on resume_request check last_resume_ts for session+token; if <2000ms respond 200 but suppress resume_event emission and skip billing. Add a small metric `resume_dedup_suppressed`.

emily: I'll patch the metric-forwarder to accept and passthrough new labels and add a temporary dashboard panel: resume_ack_lag by route and by console_cohort. Also add a tag-mismatch alert during rollouts.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: patrick/patch/resume-debounce -> staging at 21:45 UTC; emily/patch/metric-forwarder -> staging at 21:50 UTC.

ops: Long-term: change billing to require resume_ack + stream_open confirmation from runtime. File BILL-538. Also console UX needs a rollout guard: warn if idle_timeout < 5000ms or if changing affinity mode while rolling out.

jules: One more notes: many client SDKs assume idle_timeout of 30s; shortening to 1s caused visible client reconnect loops. Console should surface recommended SDK configs when changing these timeouts.

patrick: I'll add unit + integration tests for resume dedupe and billing guard.

emily: After forwarding tags are fixed, I'll backfill queries to identify all affected tenants and coordinate CS notifications.

ops: Action items summary (short): debounce patch, metric-forwarder tags, temporary dashboard, billing guard ticket, console rollout safety checks, CS outreach.

jules: Thanks. Prioritize debounce + metrics so we can avoid unnecessary rollbacks. We'll revert the console flip if we still see >5 duplicate resumes/session in 5m. :thumbsup:
